cautions: Do not use unsuffixed qwen3:4b for this comparison: the observed catalogue alias refers to a thinking-2507 model, not the selected instruct-2507 candidate.
Declared maximum context is not the benchmark context; comparisons should explicitly use num_ctx=2048.
Memory envelopes are estimates. Actual GPU residence must be checked through /api/ps and server logs.
The 24b installed model's disk size is near total dedicated VRAM; no full-residency guarantee follows from file size.

api_compatibility.structured_outputs_mechanism: Local /api/chat format JSON Schema, followed by independent application validation.
api_compatibility.scientific_note: A grammar-constrained action enum can make legality weakly discriminating; compare coordination and episode outcomes separately.
api_compatibility.hardware_support_note: Official Ollama documentation lists the RX 7800 XT under Windows ROCm support. Actual use was independently observed in the local runtime log.
api_compatibility.cloud_note: No cloud service or observation transfer was activated.

limits: Two physical validation instances and two physical held-out instances, repeated twice; repetitions are not independent instances.
Cold means model explicitly unloaded; OS filesystem cache is not flushed.
Socket/DNS timeout is not a hard wall-clock bound; late responses are rejected and overruns recorded.
Structured grammar restricts action choices; legal JSON is not evidence of good coordination.
Devstral 24B exceeded the declared 120-second preload budget; no warm quality measurement.
Selection uses validation only and is frozen before held-out testing; no universal model ranking.
M8 is frozen snapshot allocation; M10 is local inference on unchanged V1 physics, not LLM training.
A URL-type validation guard was added after the benchmark process imported the client; valid benchmark URLs and inference behavior are unchanged.
